name: Australian International School
summary: Dual Australian / IB pathways on Lorong Chuan for families wanting Aussie continuity.
body: AIS combines Australian curriculum familiarity with IB Diploma options, serving a large Australian and wider international community. Lorong Chuan sits north-east central with reasonable access from Thomson and east corridors. Sport and outdoor culture are campus signatures.
waitlistNotes: Popular entry years fill on rolling demand — contact admissions early.
